title: Inlet Beach "Barefoot Blue Carriage" 98 N. Winston Lane
h1: Inlet Beach "Barefoot Blue Carriage" 98 N. Winston Lane
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - 3 to 5 minute walk to beach- Adjacent to the Rosemary Beach racquet club- A stroll away from shopping and dining at Rosemary Beach and 30Ave- Private balcony - Private courtyard with dining and gas grill.- 2 adult bikes- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: For guests seeking more privacy and all the amenities that a house has to offer, the carriage house at Barefoot Blue offers perfect accommodations for 4 guests. This professionally decorated 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom home boasts contemporary decor with a queen bed, queen sleeper sofa, and glass walk-in shower. It's location is everything. It is by the eastern boundary of Rosemary beach opposite the tennis courts and adjacent to the Pointe in inlet Beach. It is just a short walk from the upscale boutiques and restaurants at Rosemary Beach and 30Avenue. The home comes with 2 adult bikes. The kitchenette features a cooktop, small refrigerator, microwave, and dishwasher. The living area features a flat-screen TV, cozy couch, and plenty of natural light shining through the private balcony. The bedroom also has its own flat screen TV and plenty of shelving and storage in the closet and bathroomGuests will love the privacy and amenities featured with this Villa! Sip coffee from your own balcony in the morning before heading to the farmers market in Rosemary Beach. Don't miss your chance to stay at this stylish home!
